reason: I'd only go because I can see the actual set, check the bare wheel photos and pay on collection, and the fit refund covers my worry about PCD and offset. £240 for four is a lot less than new, so if they have my fitment I'd go and look.
objection: Refurbished paint might peel or the wheel might fail again, and it's a brand new seller with no reviews, so I only have their photos to go on until I see them in person.
would_change_my_mind: If they didn't have my exact fitment in stock, or the wheels looked rough or had any hairline crack or bend when I checked them in person, I'd walk away.
